statement: The local L0 pilot retained nine exploratory cases: five complete statistical cases and four A/A rejections. Across all three n6 seeds, compact/expanded improvement is 10.88-11.24x in parent worker-call medians (adjusted lower endpoints above 10), but only 2.43-2.99x with shared reference setup and checking charged. Optimized F4 remains faster; no full-cost 10x/15x target or fresh-family result is established.
